front.title: Authenticating HTTP Tunnels with HTTP Message Signatures

abstract.t: This document specifies client authentication for HTTP tunnel establishment using HTTP Message Signatures. It covers the CONNECT method, extended CONNECT in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, and HTTP/1.1 Upgrade. It defines signature coverage and replay protection using either a client-generated nonce or a server-provided nonce obtained through an Accept-Signature challenge.
